steps.text: In the app, choose the scenario; read its introduction aloud
steps.note: First game: The Nature of the Beast (stand-alone)

steps.text: Each player picks a character shown in the app (random if you can't agree)
Each player: Player Board, 2 Main Dice, 3 Effort Dice, 1 Coin, Destiny Card and miniature
Main Dice and the Coin in your supply area; Effort Dice off the board (exhausted)
Skill tokens on the skill tracks at the values the app gives
Read your Destiny Card secretly; place it on your board, illustration up
Follow the app: Map Tiles, Points of Interest tokens and minis on the explored tile, all character minis on the starting tile
First to fulfill their Destiny wins
